landmarks.name: Stratford City Hall
landmarks.blurb: Built from 1898 and opened in January 1900, City Hall holds the council offices and an 800-seat auditorium. It was designated a National Historic Site of Canada in 1976.

landmarks.name: Market Square
landmarks.blurb: This square behind City Hall was set aside in 1834 and held the first town hall, a market house, from 1857. Farmers sold their produce here for many years, which is how Market Place got its name.

landmarks.name: Avon Theatre
landmarks.blurb: Opened in January 1901 as the Theatre Albert, a cinema and vaudeville house. The Stratford Festival bought it in 1963 and reopened it, renovated, in 1967.
